payload.title: Hollin Mere pilot check-in
payload.summary:
Check-in with the harbour office of Hollin Mere on the Tidewater pilot.

## Notes

- The harbour office would like to start in October; we come back with a start date.
- Ines sends the list of berths with their depths by the end of the month.

## Open questions

- Should skippers see the berth fees in the app during the pilot? Ines asks the harbourmaster.

action_items.text: Send the list of berths with their depths

transcript.speaker: Priya Lanthorn
transcript.text: Thanks for joining. A quick check on the pilot.

transcript.speaker: Ines Calderwood
transcript.text: We would like to start in October.

transcript.speaker: Mira Castellane
transcript.text: We'll come back to you with a start date.

transcript.speaker: Ines Calderwood
transcript.text: I'll send the list of berths with their depths by the end of the month.

transcript.speaker: Hallie Marsh
transcript.text: Will skippers see the berth fees in the app during the pilot?

transcript.speaker: Ines Calderwood
transcript.text: I have to ask the harbourmaster about that.
